scripts.package:web-dashboard: npm run build && mkdir -p ../web/client/public/releases && python3 -c "import json, pathlib, zipfile; src=pathlib.Path('dist'); version=json.loads(pathlib.Path('package.json').read_text())['version']; out=pathlib.Path(f'../web/client/public/releases/smartaihub-marketplace-capture-extension-{version}.zip'); out.unlink(missing_ok=True); z=zipfile.ZipFile(out, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED); [z.write(p, p.relative_to(src)) for p in src.rglob('*') if p.is_file()]; z.close()" && npm run verify:dashboard-package
